question.prompt:
What is the value of the following product?

\[\dfrac{3 \times 5}{9 \times 11} \times \dfrac{7 \times 9 \times 11}{3 \times 5 \times 7}\]

solutions.explanation:
Multiplying the fractions puts all the numerator factors together and all the denominator factors together:
\[
\frac{3\times5}{9\times11}\times\frac{7\times9\times11}{3\times5\times7}
=\frac{3\times5\times7\times9\times11}{9\times11\times3\times5\times7}.
\]
Each factor occurs once in the numerator and once in the denominator. All are nonzero, so they cancel, leaving \(1\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
solutions.title: Cancel common factors
